locale.btn_follow_up_hints: ماذا يمكنني أن أقول بعد ذلك؟
loader_messages: ☕ One sip of tea and I’m done 😄
🧪 Trying a few options and choosing the best one.
locale.better_audio_please: It’s better if we practice with real conversation 🎙️ Next time, please send a voice message.
locale.translation_fallback_missing: I don’t have a translation for this message yet.
locale.hints_intro: Here are a few options you can say next:
locale.hints_empty: I don’t have suggestions for this message yet. Try with the next reply.
locale.hi_message_text:
مرحبًا! أنا Nour، معلمتك في AI Language School 🙂
لنتدرّب على الإنجليزية: أرسل رسالة صوتية من 1-2 جملة 🎙️ وسأعطيك تصحيحات لطيفة.
🌐 https://ai-language-school.online/ar
locale.choose_voice_mode_text: How would you like to receive my replies: voice or text? 🎧💬
locale.msg_too_long: That’s a bit long 🙂 Try 1–2 sentences for better quality corrections.
locale.msg_to_bot: 🤖→🤖 Hey colleague! If you’re a bot, blink twice 😄 Please send me one spoken sentence.
locale.msg_error_command: Oops, I don’t know that command yet 🙈
locale.msg_next_step: Now send me a short voice message (1–2 sentences) 🎙️ I’ll correct mistakes and explain clearly 🙂
locale.stats_footer: Details and subscription management are available in the mini-app below.
locale.msg_limit_reached: I’d love to keep practicing with you, but your weekly limit is already reached 😔\nTo continue, open the subscription in the mini-app with the button below ✨\nYou can check your subscription status with /stats.
locale.msg_tts_limit_reached: You’ve reached the weekly limit for my voice replies 😔 Check /stats or change mode with /voice.
locale.msg_too_short: I couldn’t hear anything 😭 Please try a slightly longer voice message.
locale.msg_feedback_prompt: Thanks! Please send your feedback as text or a voice message 🎙️
locale.msg_feedback_needs_text_or_voice: Please send feedback as text or voice message 🎙️
locale.starter_prompt_text: Pick a starter topic 👇 I'll ask the first question.
locale.starter_question_intro: Can you introduce yourself in 2-3 sentences?
locale.starter_question_day: How was your day today? Tell me 1-2 things.
locale.starter_question_weekend: What are your plans for the weekend?
